MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Adjustable bench power and current-limiting resistors support the breadboard and relay experiments suggested by my earlier purchases.",
    "Magnet wire feels like a useful next step because it would let me wind coils around the ferrite toroid cores I already bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Brass stock, an AC motor controller, and specialized test leads require projects or equipment I have not shown a need for.",
    "Fast-blinking multicolor LEDs do not serve the simple indicator role I want, and solder paste does not address my current breadboard prototyping needs.",
    "The green LEDs fit my interests, but my previous kit included LEDs; the second bench supply also fits, but I would only choose one."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any electrical tool or component, even when its purpose differs from my small circuit projects.",
    "Similar components seem to be treated as equally useful without considering whether they add a capability or repeat something I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The practical connection between items matters: wire for my toroid cores and power for my breadboards are more compelling than a broad electronics connection.",
    "I need a specific use before choosing more supplies; compatible items can still be unnecessary when I already have enough or have selected an alternative."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my circuit-building interests but sometimes missed the specific purpose and immediate need that make a related item worth choosing."
}
